summary: Ran one pass on the WhatsApp Team Inbox. Backend: 25/25 pytest tests pass after one test-data fix (see context). Coverage: signed inbound webhook (bad signature gives 401, duplicate wamid stored once, unread count goes up, status set to waiting_team, button and interactive replies parsed), every list filter plus q/source/pagination, welcome messages rendered with the chatbot token in the button URL, text send inside the 24h window (Meta accepted it; same client_id returns the existing message, no duplicate), 422 when the window has expired, internal notes, status changes and mark-read, assignment (bad processor id gives 404, processor gets 403, assign then unassign), quick replies CRUD (processor gets 403), unread-summary and unread-by-leads, templates endpoint returns only sendable ones (loan_application_response), GP gets 403, unauthenticated is rejected, processor sees only his scope. Frontend: the three-panel inbox, search, tabs, internal note, text send, template dialog with variables and preview, window-expired banner with Send disabled, Chat icon on all 50 Leads rows, slide-out with the empty state and start button, Chat button on Lead Detail and File Detail, OPEN FULL INBOX goes to /meta/inbox?c=... All of these work.

minor.issue: The client_id duplicate check looks across all conversations. A client_id that belongs to another conversation returns that other message, which can leak data across conversations. Scope the lookup to conv_id.
User input goes into $regex without re.escape. Characters like '(' cause a 500, and it is a ReDoS risk.
json.loads(payload) has no guard, so a malformed payload gives a 500 instead of a 422.
If log_outbound returns None (client_id race or DuplicateKey), _finish_send(None, ...) crashes.
h['ref'] raises KeyError, and a missing welcome header file gives a 500. Return 404 instead.

ui_bugs.issue: There is no loading state: 'No approved templates. Sync templates…' (template-empty) shows until /inbox/templates comes back. The button URL variable is not prefilled, so staff must type the token or the send fails with 'Fill all template fields'. Consider prefilling the lead's chatbot token.
When there is no conversation (chat-sheet-empty), the OPEN FULL INBOX link is not shown. It only appears once a conversation exists. Confirm this is intended.

issues: The floating notification bell (top-right, fixed) sits visually on top of the sheet's close X and the 'CUSTOMER DETAILS' header. The close button is still clickable, but it looks cluttered.
The date filters use the browser's native date inputs (mm/dd/yyyy), not the shadcn Calendar. The 'to' date input is clipped or overflows the 312px list panel.
Raw form values show as-is ('salaried?', 'more than rs.40,000'). File Detail shows Net Salary 'NaN' (existing issue, outside this scope).

action_items: Scope the client_id duplicate lookups to conv_id in send_text, send_attachment and send_template
Apply re.escape to q in list_conversations and lead_search
Guard json.loads in send_template (return 422) and handle a None return from log_outbound in send_attachment
Add a loading state in TemplateDialog, and prefill the button token variable for loan_application_response
